questions.question: Why did the LORD stir the spirit of King Cyrus of Persia to send a proclamation across his kingdom?

answers.text: To fulfill His word spoken through Jeremiah the prophet
To answer the prayers Cyrus himself had prayed
To repay Judah for everything Babylon took

questions.question: King Cyrus said the LORD, the God of heaven, appointed him to build what for Him at Jerusalem?
King Cyrus of Persia said his own armies won him all the kingdoms of the earth. True or false?
When Cyrus let the exiles go home, what did he bring out that Nebuchadnezzar had carried away from Jerusalem?

answers.text: The articles from the house of the LORD
The crown of Judah's last king
